blocks.html:
Gutters placed on the outside of buildings shall be of noncombustible, corrosion-resistant material in accordance with Chapter 11 of the New York City Plumbing Code. Gutters and vertical sections of exterior leaders shall be adequately anchored. Gutters and leaders installed more than 15 feet (4572 mm) above grade shall be designed to resist loads in accordance with Chapter 16 of this code.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
